$comment: F7 auto-post-approved-rules (opt-in, flag `auto-post`, off by default). The rules list is EMPTY: nothing auto-posts until you write a rule. All field names and limits are proposed, not approved. A rule: { id, target, minScore, layouts?, maxPerDay }. minScore compares to the ranker's candidate score (data/clip/ranking.json; carried into post.json as source.score). Uploads are always private. autoUpload false = rules only mark matching drafts approved; true additionally uploads them (YouTube Shorts target only), after a run with no output live or starting.

maxPerDay.counts: auto approvals (and, separately, auto uploads) per UTC day per rule
